model_output.score_comment_short: The work is specific to child welfare, but most bullets describe duties.
model_output.score_comment_long: Home visits, court reports, and family meetings show the range of your casework. The resume rarely explains how you handle that work or what followed. A few concrete examples would make the experience easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: A reader can identify your field and responsibilities quickly. They may need more detail to distinguish your casework from a standard job description.
model_output.first_impression: Your current role centers on families involved with child protective services. Monthly family team meetings are worth keeping because they show a regular part of your work with families.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Write case plans and court reports" does not explain what you document or how the reports are used, leaving a reader to guess at your part in the process.
model_output.summary: Your work moves from assistance intake to ongoing family services casework, with an Ohio LMSW and a Master of Social Work. The current role combines home visits, service coordination, and court documentation. It reads as a direct-service caseworker role rather than a supervisory one. A reviewer may still wonder how you navigate safety concerns and service needs in practice, making it difficult to assess the complexity of the cases you handle.
